title: Mr. Madras
desc: An industrialist hires a young man to settle her disputes with a local criminal on her behalf.

title: Sema Ragalai
desc: In order to go abroad in search of his dream job, Satya agrees to kidnap his friend's lover. However, he abducts the wrong woman and is stuck with her.

title: Rajadurai
desc: Rajadurai, a police officer, succeeds in capturing Mayandi, a gangster, and sending him to jail. Later, Mayandi kidnaps Rajadurai's son, Vijay, and raises him as a criminal.

title: Veetla Eli Veliyila Puli
desc: An otherwise confident Purshottaman finds himself completely dominated by his overbearing wife. Desperate to escape his uncomfortable situation, he turns to his colleague, Sivaraman, for help.

title: Paarai
desc: Durai Raj, a lorry driver, has only one friend, Jayaram. However, when his friend dies, Durai Raj strives to support his family.
